'''Faya''' was one of the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]], ancient controversial [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]] and lawgivers of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The other three Sages were [[Sistros/Legends|Sistros]], [[Yanjon/Legends|Yanjon]], and [[Braata/Legends|Braata]].
